# Copilot Instructions

Use this file as the default guidance for this repository. For deeper context, see `AGENTS.md`.

## Architecture First
- `app/` is the composition root (navigation, DI, networking, orchestration). Start from `app/src/main/java/com/vonage/android/navigation/AppNavHost.kt` and `app/src/main/java/com/vonage/android/di/`.
- `vonage-video-core/` wraps OpenTok/Vonage SDK behind `VonageVideoClient` and `CallFacade` abstractions.
- Optional capabilities live in `vonage-feature-*` modules; avoid adding feature flags directly in `app/` when a module boundary exists.

## Non-Negotiables
- Treat `config/app-config.json` as source of truth for runtime/build feature behavior.
- Never hand-edit `gradle/generated-config.properties`; it is generated by `generateVonageConfig`.
- Keep generated theme/config outputs plugin-driven (`com.vonage.theme-generator`, `com.vonage.json-config`).

## Feature Toggle Pattern
- Optional feature modules use flavor dimensions with `enabled`/`disabled` variants (example: `vonage-feature-chat/build.gradle.kts`).
- Keep public contracts in `src/main`; keep behavior implementations in `src/enabled` and `src/disabled`.
- When changing a feature API, update both flavor variants.

## Runtime Integration Touchpoints
- Session bootstrap path: `APIService.getSession()` -> `SessionRepository` -> `MeetingRoomScreenViewModel.connect(...)` -> `VonageVideoClient.initializeSession(...)`.
- `BuildConfig.BASE_API_URL` affects networking, deep links, and share links (`RetrofitModule.kt`, `AppNavHost.kt`, `util/navigateToShare.kt`).
- DI is Hilt-based; plugin points (chat/reactions) are injected into core client in `SdkModule.provideVonageVideoClient(...)`.

## Workflow Commands
- After config edits: `./gradlew generateVonageConfig`
- Install debug build: `./gradlew installDebug`
- Unit tests: `./gradlew test` (or module-specific, e.g. `./gradlew :vonage-video-core:test`)
- Instrumented tests: `./gradlew connectedAndroidTest` or `./gradlew pixelDebugAndroidTest`
- Quality gates: `./gradlew detekt` and `./gradlew koverHtmlReport`

## Conventions
- Kotlin + Java 17 across modules.
- Compose lint rules are strict via detekt (`build-tools/detekt/detekt.yml`).
- Contributions are expected from `develop` branch (see `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md`).
